description: Create a new keyword with an existing one's settings: give the new term (or the same term with another groupId, since a term is tracked once per group). It copies the kind, platforms, context, every matching rule, the monthly mention cap and the comments setting; review apps and feeds only when listed in include (reviewSources, feeds), since two keywords on one app collect and bill every review twice. It is a new keyword: $5 per month, and its last 30 days come in at once.

groupId.description: The group of the copy (grp_...); omit for the original's group.

include.description: Also copy these: reviewSources (its review apps) and feeds (its RSS or Atom feeds). Off by default, since two keywords on one app or feed collect, and bill, every review or item twice.

term.description: The term of the copy. The same term as the original only in another group (groupId): a term is tracked once per group. Wrap it in double quotes for the exact phrase only.

name: duplicate_keyword
title: Duplicate keyword
